findings.subject: [reviewer P1] Draft gate CREATE path always HOLDs (legacy-shaped decision input)
findings.description: gov-draft-pr fed decideDraftPrAction a truncated legacy result/current; verifyExternalReviewResult always failed (verdict undefined, bundle_sha256/heads mismatch, missing authorization_source) so action=NONE on every CREATE attempt. DRAFT_PR_ALREADY_SATISFIED was the only reachable outcome.
findings.recommendedDisposition: Resolved in 27e1cb6: canonical CREATE decision derived from promotion authority + draft_pr caps; existing PRs are bound (already satisfied) or controller-reconciled; CREATE covered by a new dry-run test.

findings.subject: [reviewer P2] Reviewed baseHead staleness check dropped
findings.description: evaluatePromotionAuthority compared tree/patch/head/branch but not baseHead; a base advance after review (merge-base unchanged) would pass both gates on a stale reviewed base, violating RC1A §8 candidate identity.
findings.recommendedDisposition: Resolved in 27e1cb6: inventory.baseHead vs reviewJob.candidateIdentity.baseHead -> HOLD CANDIDATE_IDENTITY_MISMATCH; unit test added.

findings.subject: [reviewer P2] Delivery staleness jobId/generation unenforceable; absent cardId skipped the check
findings.description: delivery record (autoloop.external-review-delivery/v2) carries no jobId/generation, so RC1A §17 stale-delivery leg cannot be enforced; a delivery without cardId skipped the DELIVERY_STALE check entirely.
findings.recommendedDisposition: Resolved in 27e1cb6: readDeliveryEvidence now REQUIRES non-empty cardId (DELIVERY_INVALID otherwise); residual jobId/generation binding documented as card-spec limitation + follow-on.

findings.subject: [reviewer P3] Card spec outcome row 7 overclaimed jobId/generation staleness
findings.description: The spec listed stale-delivery HOLD for job/generation mismatch which the current delivery schema cannot enforce.
findings.recommendedDisposition: Resolved in 7e04f4e: row 7 qualified (card/branch/candidate drift) + known-limitation section added.

summary: PGMA1 independent review: REPAIR (reviewer P1/P2/P3 findings), all resolved and covered by new tests; re-verification PASS.
